meta.fragility: one input at a time +-tau: tithi/nakshatra boundaries and moonrise tauL (30 s | 150 s, 600 s on F/S sun days), sankrantis and new moons tauS (30 s | 600 s); fragile = (date, label, flags) changes; alt = every date seen incl. the base date; sun-day S/U flags within 2 days of the date mark the row fragile with date +-1 added; a unit absent in the base run whose label flips adds its date to the nearest fragile row of the same id
meta.labels: [masa ordinal 0 = CHAITRA, adhika, kshaya masa|null]; purnimanta Krishna half has kshaya null
meta.row: [id, date (panchang day), label|null, tithi|null, kala|null, kalaStartMs, kalaEndMs (point kala: equal), muhuratStartMs, muhuratEndMs, muhuratStartSrc, muhuratEndSrc (L = limb boundary, S = sun-derived), paranaStartMs, paranaEndMs, paranaStartSrc, paranaEndSrc, flags (sorted OccFlag names), fragP, fragB, altP, altB]; the kala of an Ekadashi row is the kala of the fast day (sunrise smarta, arunodaya vaishnava); moonrise kala instants are Moon-derived; sankranti rows have kala null and kalaStart = kalaEnd = the sankranti instant; muhurat only for a non-empty interval kala; nakshatra rows: kala of the rule
